title: Intake interview: Office Manager
source_system: Interview (Office Manager)

title: Intake interview: President
source_system: Interview (President)
what_it_shows: He answered the 2025 SPRS checklist himself; the company has no incident response plan, no DoD-approved medium assurance certificate and no DIBNet account; in May 2026 a foreign-national builder service engineer worked at a CNC machine with a drawing posted on it; he reads CUI suite email on his personal phone; the company holds no facility clearance

source_system: Interviews (CNC Programmer, Quality Inspector, Lead Machinist)

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (President, Office Manager, CNC Programmer, Quality Inspector, Lead Machinist, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; machines keep running loaded programs for about one shift; only the CNC Programmer can program complex parts; nothing ships without inspection records; programs saved in the job folders sync to SYS-01 within minutes

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)

source_system: Payroll separation (EV-001) compared with the SYS-01 and SYS-02 user exports and the Prime A portal user list; sign-in logs

title: Gap analysis interview: Office Manager, 2026-07-14
source_system: Interview (Office Manager)

title: Gap analysis interview: CNC Programmer, 2026-07-14
source_system: Interview (CNC Programmer)
what_it_shows: In June 2026 he pasted paragraphs of a Prime A material specification, which carries a CUI marking and a distribution statement, into a free public chatbot from the CAM workstation to get a plain-language summary, and he asked for an approved tool; he installs software on SYS-03 without approval; personal USB drives are used on SYS-03; CAM and DNC software updates are installed by hand and are behind the vendors' current releases

title: Gap analysis interviews: President, Quality Inspector, Lead Machinist and CNC Machinists
source_system: Interviews (President, Quality Inspector, Lead Machinist, 2 CNC Machinists)
what_it_shows: The President would give DoD access to equipment and information, and nothing in the lease or MSP contract prevents it; no security contacts are on file for Prime A or Supplier B; the President uses his laptop at home with no written rules; the Quality Inspector installs CMM software updates by hand and uses vendor update media without scanning; the Lead Machinist and machinists state that visitors and builder service engineers are not escorted consistently

title: Shop walkthrough, 2026-07-16
source_system: Shop floor, inspection room, office and dock (observation, with the CNC Programmer and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Printed drawings and setup sheets in job folders at the machines; customer drawings carry the customer's markings and distribution statements, while setup sheets, CAM printouts and USB drives carry no CUI marking; the office drawing cabinet unlocked; scrap drawings and setup sheets in the general trash; 4 USB drives with no identifiable owner at the 2 older machines, and personal drives in use; the roll-up dock door open during the shift; the office and inspection room unlocked during the day; file shares on the networked CNC controllers visible from the shop network; 4 VoIP desk phones, laptops on Wi-Fi and the NC program traffic on the same subnet; no sign-in banner or CUI notice on the SYS-01 sign-in page or the computers; password entry masked; laptop cameras show an indicator light

source_system: SYS-01, SYS-02, ERP and Prime A portal user lists compared with the staff roster; MSP technician access list; termination record; designation letter; Office Manager and MSP lead technician interviews
what_it_shows: The 4 named SYS-01 users match the staff roster on 2026-08-11 and their access matches their jobs; the President approved them before go-live by email of 2026-03-02; no approval record for 2 of the 4 SYS-01 accounts; account types, group membership and privileges are not documented; the ITAR job folders are open to all 4 suite users; the MSP global administrator account is shared by 3 technicians and its password was not changed after a technician left the MSP in May 2026 (changed 2026-08-12); the MSP technician list received 2026-08-10 shows one technician without MFA; no account reviews; disabled accounts are never deleted

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: Hire orientation checklist; training records; interviews with 5 of 7 employees
what_it_shows: Hire orientation covers safety and quality, with one line about keeping drawings in the shop; no annual, role-based, insider threat or privacy training; no phishing simulations or reminders; 4 of 5 employees interviewed could not say what CUI is

title: Control assessment: log review interviews
source_system: SYS-01 audit settings; RMM session log; firewall log settings; Office Manager and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: SYS-01 audit records, the RMM session log and firewall logs are never reviewed; no review frequency, indicators or reporting path is defined

title: Control assessment: component inventory review
source_system: MSP RMM device list; walkthrough of the shop on 2026-08-11
what_it_shows: The RMM list holds the 4 computers with hostname, serial, operating system and owner and no duplicates; the 5 CNC machines, the CMM, the printer, the firewall, the switch, 4 VoIP phones, USB drives and the SYS-01 tenant are not on it; no CMMC asset category or CUI location is recorded; the company has never reviewed the list; printed drawings were in the general trash on 2026-08-11

title: Control assessment: backup review
source_system: MSP backup job report (July 2026), settings and provider status; SYS-01 version settings; MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 nightly image jobs of SYS-03 and SYS-04 succeeded in July with checksum results; 30 days kept; the MSP confirmed on 2026-08-07 that the backup provider is a commercial cloud that is not FedRAMP authorized; FIPS validation of its encryption is unknown; no full restore test is recorded; firewall configuration, CAM post-processors and DNC settings are not backed up on a defined schedule; SYS-01 keeps file versions

title: Control assessment: privileged sign-in tests
source_system: Sign-in attempts with the MSP present to SYS-01, the firewall, the RMM console and local administrator on SYS-03
what_it_shows: SYS-01 administrator sign-in required MFA; the firewall management login, one technician's RMM console login and local administrator sign-in on SYS-03 and SYS-04 accepted a password alone; the MSP enabled MFA on that RMM login on 2026-08-12

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Draft POL-03; interviews with the President, the Office Manager and 3 employees
what_it_shows: No requirement or time limit for staff to report a suspected incident (POL-03 was a draft); 2 of 3 employees would tell the MSP directly, not the company; no medium assurance certificate, DIBNet account or prime security contacts

title: Control assessment: USB media walkthrough and test
source_system: Walkthrough of the older CNC machines on 2026-08-11; antivirus device control settings on SYS-03
what_it_shows: No restriction on USB storage on SYS-03, SYS-04 or the CNC machines; 4 unlabeled USB drives with no identifiable owner at the older machines were usable on SYS-03 after scanning

title: Control assessment: visitor log review
source_system: Visitor log, June to August 2026; service tickets; Lead Machinist interview
what_it_shows: The visitor log is blank for 6 of 9 known visits in June and July 2026; no retention period; the log is never reviewed; the May 2026 foreign-national service visit was not recorded or reported

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Termination record for the part-time programmer (last day 2026-03-27); account disable dates; key sign-out sheet; Office Manager interview
what_it_shows: Access was disabled 110 days after his last day and no time limit is defined; MFA registrations and the Prime A portal credential were not revoked at termination; no exit interview on CUI and export control duties; the building key was returned on the last day (key sign-out sheet); his work files remain in the shared job folders

title: Control assessment: external service provider review
source_system: MSP contract; MSP SOC 2 Type 2 report (12 months ending 2026-04-30, received 2026-08-05); FedRAMP Marketplace listing for the CUI suite offering; backup service terms
what_it_shows: The MSP's backup subcontractor stores CUI outside a FedRAMP-authorized boundary; the MSP contract's confidentiality clause covers company data; the contract has no named-account, MFA, U.S.-person or incident notice terms and no CMMC responsibility matrix; the provider CRM is not on file; MSP monthly reports are received but not reviewed; U.S.-person confirmation for technicians was not received by fieldwork end

title: Control assessment: boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall rule export; network walkthrough; connection test from a laptop on staff Wi-Fi to a networked CNC machine share
what_it_shows: Inbound traffic denied by default with only established sessions returning; guest Wi-Fi on its own network; the only external connection is through the firewall; no internal managed interfaces; firewall logs stay on the device and are not monitored; a laptop on staff Wi-Fi could open the file share on a networked CNC machine

title: Control assessment: encryption review and test
source_system: Encryption status report; checks of SYS-03, SYS-04 and one laptop on 2026-08-11
what_it_shows: The laptop checked is encrypted; SYS-03 and SYS-04 hold synced CUI with no disk encryption
